basic_info.description: Superb single-family home across from USF in one of my favorite areas in San Francisco. The main living room has fantastic park views of the USF campus. Every room feels grand and inviting on the entertainment level. The home went through a fantastic renovation from the floors, the kitchen and the lower level game room. This is move-in ready. You will love how light and bright the home is because of the interior patio and oversized windows. Views from the Primary Bedroom and one of the best features in the new addition, the rec room just off the great backyard. The special feature of this house is its central location throughout the city. You also get access to USF's Koret Rec center.  2 Car Parking!!
